theses.thesis: Energy is the only scorable-adjacent eligible theme with a clean trend tag (hurst_tag=trend), the strongest durability_bar (0.80), the broadest breadth (0.90), and no crowding (z=0.24), making it the cleanest trend-gate-eligible stay among the leaders.
